properties.name: variant
properties.description:
`standard` (default) anchors the sheet to the bottom edge.
`detached` floats it with margin on every side.
Both variants always render a scrim and trap focus.

properties.name: closeable
properties.description: Show a close icon-button in the top-end corner of the header

properties.name: scrimDismissible
properties.description: Whether clicking the scrim closes the sheet

properties.name: topDivider
properties.description: Show divider between header and content

properties.name: bottomDivider
properties.description: Show divider between content and actions

properties.name: scrollShadow
properties.description:
Retained for API compatibility, but now a no-op: the content area
always plain-scrolls when it overflows (no scroll shadow / edge fades).
Setting this has no visual effect.

properties.name: headlineAlign
properties.description:
Inline-axis alignment of the headline text. `start` (default) reads
left in LTR / right in RTL, `end` reads right in LTR / left in RTL,
`center` is direction-agnostic. Use the matching `::part(headline)`
selector for finer control (e.g. `text-align: justify`).

properties.name: contentAlign
properties.description:
Inline-axis alignment of the slotted content. Inherits to all
default-slot children, so prose, lists, and forms all pick it up.
`start` (default) reads left in LTR / right in RTL, `end` reads
right in LTR / left in RTL, `center` is direction-agnostic.
Slotted children that explicitly set their own `text-align` win.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Bottom Sheet
description: Supplementary content anchored to the bottom of the screen. Slides up over the page with a drag handle, an optional headline and close button, and an optional actions row. Both variants are modal: they render a scrim, trap focus, lock body scroll and close on Escape.

notes: System sheet detents replace detached/standard CSS layouts.

Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, form association, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.
